Hello all,

I have read the VEKN Tournament Rules and have some questions :

1)
The Sabbat War expansion release will be the october 31. Can a VEKN
sealed deck be done that day ?

And when it will be possible to ask for the sanction of the VEKN ?

2)
The rule said that the Limited decks must contain a minimum of forty
cards and a maximum of ninety cards.

How many booster the organiser must give them ? Exemple : The booster
contain 20 card (and some vampire…). How many booster i must give to
the player ? 4 ? 5 ? 6 ? More ?

3)
The stage of deck construction :
a) Each player receives an assortment of sealed product.
b) Each player then creates a tournament deck that meets the Sealed-
Deck size requirements found in the game's V:EKN Floor Rules.
c) Players record on a decklist every card they intend to play in their
decks.
d) It’s time to the real fun, it’s time to play !

It’s ok to do the construction like this ?
I would like to not use the Sealed Deck Swap or Trade. It’s ok ?

It’s all for now…

Thank's,

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Khaleph Alendis <kha...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> I have read the VEKN Tournament Rules and have some questions :
>
> 1)
> The Sabbat War expansion release will be the october 31. Can a VEKN
> sealed deck be done that day ?

Yes, as per the V:EKN tournament rules [4.3]

> And when it will be possible to ask for the sanction of the VEKN ?

It is already possible.
Send your request (with all pertinent information) to me via e-mail.

> 2)
> The rule said that the Limited decks must contain a minimum of forty
> cards and a maximum of ninety cards.
>
> How many booster the organiser must give them ? Exemple : The booster

> contain 20 card (and some vampire…). How many booster i must give to

> the player ? 4 ? 5 ? 6 ? More ?

However many the tournament coordinator chooses.
Note: The Sabbat War expansion will possibly be packaged differently
than the Sabbat expansion was - it may come in regular boosters instead
of mega-boosters.

> 3)
> The stage of deck construction :
> a) Each player receives an assortment of sealed product.
> b) Each player then creates a tournament deck that meets the Sealed-
> Deck size requirements found in the game's V:EKN Floor Rules.
> c) Players record on a decklist every card they intend to play in
their
> decks.
> d) It’s time to the real fun, it’s time to play !
>
> It’s ok to do the construction like this ?
> I would like to not use the Sealed Deck Swap or Trade. It’s ok ?

Yes, as per the V:EKN rules. [7.2]
Having the players recording decklists is also just an
option - it isn't mandatory.
